observations:
Torah LM2/29 contains only one bechina equation in the source text — יחודים והזווגים = בחינת בטול אסור — and it is already captured in the dataset and assigned to Package 1. The spec for new packages requires '3+ concepts connected by explicit bechina language in the source text that form an independent domain not covered by the existing packages.' This criterion is not met.

Candidate clusters examined:

1. HALACHIC QUESTION / SIGN OF DAMAGE cluster: The teaching describes how a shaalah (halachic question about a mixture) signals a פגם ביחוד (damage to a supernal union). This pattern — earthly problem mirrors heavenly damage — is significant, but the Rebbe formulates it entirely as a 'סימן' (sign) and causal reading, never as bechina. He does not say 'the question IS bechina of the supernal damage.' Without explicit bechina language, no package can be formed.

2. BETROTHAL / MARRIAGE / PERMISSION transformation cluster: The teaching describes how ארוסה (betrothed, forbidden) becomes נשואה (married, permitted). This appears as an illustration of the central bechina, not as a separate bechina cluster. The Rebbe frames it with 'וְזֶה בְּחִינַת...' meaning 'this is an expression/example of' — directing the reader back to the already-stated central equation (yichud = biṭṭul isur), not establishing arus/nasui as an independent bechina pair.

3. VERSE-CONCEPT cluster: The two halves of Psalms 68:7 — 'אֱלֹקִים מוֹשִׁיב יְחִידִים בַּיְתָה' and 'מוֹצִיא אֲסִירִים בַּכּוֹשָׁרוֹת' — are both read as proofs for the central teaching. They do not form an independent bechina domain; they are deployed as exegetical support for Package 1's equation.

SUMMARY: Torah LM2/29 is one of the most compact Torahs in LM2, containing a single, tightly-stated bechina equation. Its entire structure is:
  [Earthly shaalah (question about mixtures)] --siman--> [Damage to supernal yichud]
  [Supernal yichud] <--bechina--> [Biṭṭul isur]
The teaching makes one conceptual claim (yichud = biṭṭul isur) and supports it with three illustrations (betrothal/marriage, two verses). There is no material for additional packages.
